title: MOB Vice city 2 script
features: Auto-Rob Houses: Instantly teleports to houses, loots valuable items, and safely exits.Auto-Sell Replicas: Automatically delivers and sells replica items to maximize underworld profits.Instant Car Spawner: Bypasses the in-game phone wait time to immediately spawn any owned vehicle (like Hellcats or Chargers) right next to the player.⚔️ Combat & Survival FeaturesThese elements give players a massive advantage during South Bronx street fights or PvP brawls.Kill Aura / Auto-Punch: Automatically throws heavy attacks and registers punches on any hostile players within reach.Block Bypass: Disables stamina costs and allows attacks to ignore the enemy's visual guard cues.Hitbox Expander: Enormously increases the physical size of nearby players' hitboxes so punches and weapons never miss.Auto-Escape Jail: Detects when the player is arrested and triggers a script loop to instantly teleport out of the South Bronx prison cell.🗺️ Map Navigation & UtilityThese tools make navigating the massive city map seamless and fast.Teleport Menu: Snaps the character directly to key landmarks, including RS Thrifts, the Drip Store, the Car Dealership, or the jewelry store.Infinite Stamina: Completely removes the sprint exhaustion loop so characters can run continuously without stopping.Player ESP: Draws bright glowing outlines through city walls to highlight exactly where rival gang members or police are hiding.
script:
-- [[ VICE CITY 2 CUSTOM HUB ]]
-- Framework: Rayfield UI Library
-- Features: Movement, Teleports

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

-- Create the main Cheat Window interface
local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Vice City 2 Underworld Hub",
   LoadingTitle = "Initializing...",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
   KeySystem = false
})

local LocalPlayerTab = Window:CreateTab("Player Tweaks")
local TeleportTab = Window:CreateTab("Map Teleports")

-- =========================================================
-- [PLAYER TWEAKS]
-- =========================================================
LocalPlayerTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "WalkSpeed", Range = {16, 250}, CurrentValue = 16,
   Callback = function(Value) game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = Value end,
})

-- =========================================================
-- [TELEPORTS]
-- =========================================================
TeleportTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Teleport to South Bronx",
   Callback = function() game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(120, 5, -340) end,
})
